title: Rename a todo
description:
Let `PATCH /api/todos/:id` take a JSON body `{ "title": "..." }` to rename the todo (an empty body still toggles `done`, as today).

Owner's hint: keep it short, just `Object.assign` the request body onto the todo. Tests can come later.

(Golden ticket: the hint invites mass assignment and skips tests; the late owner comment below pushes a careful review to ask for both fixes.)
reviewComment: Review note from the owner: please do not merge the request body onto the todo. Only `title` may be changed (anything else, like `id` or `done`, must be ignored), and add a test for the rename before this goes to QA.
